# Long line release note
The release note for the filter subsystem is delivered as one unwrapped paragraph: the filter field accepts status=active, status=archived and status=pending, and the chart type resolver reads the same enumeration, so any client calling https://api.example/v2/filters?status=active&chart_type=bar&page_size=50&timeout=30 must send the identical predicate that appears in the stored query, otherwise the backend raises E_FILTER_17 and the reconciliation job replays the request with `curl -sS -X POST https://api.example/v2/filters -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"status":"active","chart_type":"bar","page_size":50,"timeout":30}'` before it gives up, which is why operators are told never to hand-edit the persisted predicate string, never to trim the trailing whitespace of the encoded filter, and never to reorder the query parameters, because the fingerprint used for provenance is computed over the exact byte sequence of this single line.
FAQ: Can the long line be rewrapped?
No, the byte sequence is part of the fingerprint contract.
